title: Holding Multiplier on Damage Allowances for Deposit-Program Ridgeline Special Order Services Items
content:
The time a ready Ridgeline Special Order Services item was held before pickup or delivery sets the holding multiplier on the damage allowance of an order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent.

**Clause.** The holding multiplier depends on the calendar days from the ready date to the completed date: more than 45 days gives a holding multiplier of 1.1; more than 21 days and not more than 45 days gives 1.05; otherwise the holding multiplier is 1.

The damage allowance is multiplied by the holding multiplier in the same product as the order total billed and the percentage at which the allowance is figured, before that product is rounded to the nearest cent.

## Day bands

| Calendar days from ready date to completed date | Holding multiplier |
|---|---|
| 46 or more | 1.1 |
| 22 to 45 | 1.05 |
| 0 to 21 | 1 |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical ready date 1 March)

| Completed date | Days held | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 22 March | 21 | 1 |
| 23 March | 22 | 1.05 |
| 15 April | 45 | 1.05 |
| 16 April | 46 | 1.1 |
